description: This walk explores the journey from Mornington Crescent to Great Portland Street, tracing changes in housing, work, education, leisure and community. Along the route, participants encounter layers of Camden's social history while experiencing a gradual shift in sound, architecture and atmosphere. The crossing of Albany Street marks a key moment in this journey.

factsheet.heading: About the walk
paragraphs: This walk explores the transition between Mornington Crescent and Great Portland Street through Camden's social and architectural history. Along the route, we consider housing, education, work, leisure and social reform, and how these are reflected in the changing character of the streets. The route is currently being developed through Open City's Golden Key Academy, and some details may continue to evolve before the festival.

factsheet.heading: Golden Key Academy
paragraphs:
The Golden Key Academy is a course training up insightful and engaging guides dedicated to explaining London and bringing its many stories to life. This tour is part of a wider collection of tours created by Golden Key Academy guides for the Open House Festival celebrating their conclusion of the eight month course.  Further information on the Golden Key Academy can be found here https://open-city.org.uk/golden-key-academy
If you would like to attend this tour, please ensure you have booked a ticket before turning up.
